tools.name: get_recording
tools.description: Start here. Summarizes a Traceo bug recording from its share link: page, environment (browser, viewport, locale), duration, event counts, the first errors and failed requests, the user actions leading up to the first error, and which tool to call next.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Console logs, network requests and user actions merged in time order, with times relative to recording start (+12.4s). Best view for reproducing a bug. Narrow with from_s/to_s around an error.

tools.name: get_console_logs
tools.description: Browser console output captured during the recording, one line per entry. Secrets are redacted.

tools.name: get_network_requests
tools.description: HTTP requests captured during the recording, one line each: time, method, status, URL (query strings stripped), duration, type, size. No request/response bodies are captured. Sensitive headers are redacted.

tools.name: get_user_actions
tools.description: Clicks, inputs and navigations the reporter performed, in order, with target element and page path.

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Comments the reporter attached to the recording when sharing it.

tools.name: get_thumbnail
tools.description: A still image of the recorded page (the recording thumbnail).

tools.name: get_frames
tools.description: Stills from the recording video, captured after each click, error and failed request plus an even spread. Pass at_s to see the screen at a moment (e.g. the time of an error from get_timeline), or from_s/to_s for a range. Returns up to 6 images.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_console_logs" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Browser console output captured during the recording, one line per entry. Secrets are redacted.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_network_requests, get_comments · Private data: get_console_logs · Public sink: get_recording.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_network_requests, get_comments · Private data: get_console_logs · Public sink: get_recording

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
